_fixture_note: FiinQuant-only signals built from web/seed/npl/snapshot.json series. S3: NPL fell and coverage fell versus the previous quarter. S4: Q4 NPL fell and the change sits inside the min and max of that bank's other Q4 changes, when at least two other Q4 changes exist. The grid is every quarter in the source file, with the eight large banks listed first on screen. Group 2 loans and write-offs are not in this file, so a decline without S3 or S4 stays missing rather than clean. Nguồn: FiinQuant (FiinGroup).
